responsibility: Provides target-macro overrides for rs6000 processors that have only a single-precision floating-point unit, such as Xilinx-based 405/440 APU systems. It redefines the floating-point capability macros from rs6000.h so backend code can distinguish single-only, double-capable, soft-float, and simple-FPU cases, and it adjusts UNITS_PER_FP_WORD accordingly, making this the configuration header that teaches the backend the register-width and capability model of these reduced FPUs.
